mismatch.body: The campaign's recipient group was dropped or merged. Click "Send to all" to rebuild it — the list is rebuilt from the source before you confirm any send.
mismatch.cloneBody: This campaign was duplicated with a foreign source group ({{name}}) but no mapping. Pick a source and remap.

unmapped.title: There are unmapped fields

summary.title: Send summary
summary.subject: Subject
summary.staleTitle: The send summary cannot be shown
summary.staleBody: The loaded data does not belong to this campaign. Close this window and open it again. Sending is blocked until then.

supervisor.label: Also send a report to supervisors
supervisor.byColumn: A separate report will be sent to supervisors, using the "{{name}}" column. You can cancel this.
supervisor.byAccount: A separate report will be sent to the supervisors configured on the account. You can cancel this.
supervisor.off: No report will be sent to supervisors. Recipients get the email as usual.
supervisor.notEmailTitle: The selected column is not an email column
supervisor.notEmailBody: The column "{{name}}" is marked as the supervisor column, but it does not hold email addresses — so no supervisor would receive a report. Fix it on the mapping screen before sending.
supervisor.isRecipientTitle: The selected column is the recipient's own address
supervisor.isRecipientBody: The column "{{name}}" is the recipient's own address. Ticking this box sends every agent a report about themselves.

summary.combinedNote: A recipient from a regular group (not from the source) — a mapped field is replaced with an empty string.

result.successDesc: The campaign was sent through the existing pipeline. The sender replaces the fields per recipient.
result.supervisorQueued: The supervisor report request was recorded (no. {{id}}).
result.supervisorUnknown: The supervisor report status is not available in this environment.
result.supervisorNotQueuedTitle: The campaign was sent — but the supervisor report was not recorded
result.supervisorNotQueuedBody: Delivery to recipients completed normally. The supervisor report was not queued, so no supervisor will receive a report for this send. Please contact support.

manage.title: Smart Send campaigns

preview.title: Test send (agent sample)

banner.title: A sample of real agents
banner.body: One email will be sent to the address you enter, containing up to 5 real agents from the campaign's data source — with their resolved values and a link that renders the campaign exactly as that agent will receive it. Unmapped fields and empty cells are flagged explicitly. The agents themselves receive nothing.

preview.toHelper: The email goes to this address only.
preview.toTooLong: The address is longer than 50 characters. Use a shorter address.
preview.seedHelper: The same sample id and the same position return the same agents, so you can re-check the same agent after fixing the sheet.
preview.countError: The agent count could not be loaded.

errors.badRequest: The test email could not be sent with these details. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.session: Your session has expired. Sign in again and try again.
errors.notFound: The campaign or its data-source mapping was not found. Make sure the campaign is linked to a data source and the mapping is saved.
errors.noPermission: You do not have permission to send a test email. Contact your account administrator.
errors.noCandidates: The campaign's data source has no matching agents to send to.
errors.tooLarge: The test email is too large to send. Reduce the number of agents in the sample and try again.
errors.invalidEmail: The destination address is invalid or longer than 50 characters. Enter a valid address of up to 50 characters.
errors.serverError: The test send failed because of a server error. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.featureOff: Data sources are not enabled for this account. Contact your account administrator.

preview.toHelperMulti: Comma or space adds an address · up to {{max}}
preview.toDropped: {{n}} address(es) not added — the maximum is {{max}}

viewOnlyTooltip: This source has no identity columns — it cannot be sent to
historicalVersionEditNote: In a historical version only column searchability can be changed — the display name and type describe a send that already went out.
lastVersionFailedTooltip: The latest version failed; the active version is: V{{n}}

emptyState.title: No data sources yet
emptyState.subtitle: Upload an Excel or CSV file — every column becomes an available data field

wizard.title: Upload data source
wizard.dragHere: Drag an xlsx or csv file here, or click to browse
wizard.clientFieldNone: Do not update a recipient field
wizard.clientFieldHint: Choosing a recipient field updates the recipient's own record — the value from the column overwrites what is there. An empty cell deletes nothing; the existing value is kept
wizard.clientFieldSummaryRow: The {{field}} field will be updated from column «{{column}}»
wizard.clientFieldBlankNotice: Column «{{column}}»: {{blank}} empty rows out of {{total}}. An empty cell deletes nothing — the recipient's existing value is kept
wizard.clientFieldScopeNotice: The counts above describe the file. Only recipients the system resolves — matched on email or mobile, or created by this upload — are updated, and only one row per recipient
wizard.clientFieldVersionReminder: Recipient-field updates are not carried over from a previous version — they must be chosen again on every upload
wizard.clientFieldDateNotice: The {{field}} field is a date field, so it is updated only in rows where the value in column «{{column}}» is in dd/mm/yyyy format — in the other rows the existing value is kept
wizard.identityBanner: All other columns will be saved as dynamic data fields using the file headers
wizard.noIdentityWarning: No identity columns were marked — the source will be saved for viewing, search and export only, and cannot be sent to
wizard.createMissingClients: Create new recipients for identities that do not exist in the system
wizard.createAsPending: Create the new recipients as pending
wizard.createAsPendingHint: A recipient created as pending is excluded from sending until approved. Applies to new recipients only — an existing recipient's status is never changed
wizard.descriptionKeepHint: If left empty, the existing description is kept
wizard.newVersionNotice: A source with this name exists — the file will be uploaded as a new version (V{{n}}) and the previous version will be kept
wizard.abandonConfirm: The upload will be cancelled — leave?

errors.fileTooLarge: The file exceeds the maximum size ({{max}} MB)
errors.invalidExtension: Unsupported file type — you can upload csv, xls, xlsx or tsv
errors.maxRowsExceeded: The file contains more than {{max}} rows — above the allowed quota
errors.nameTooLong: Source name is longer than 100 characters
